verdict.rationale: Greptile lets customers turn off logging to make chats private, and in self-hosted deployments logs stay on customer servers only. Self-hosting on your own infrastructure, including air-gapped setups, gives indirect control over where data lives. However, the vendor reserves the right to aggregate and anonymize customer data and use it for AI training, which limits user control in the hosted service. Missing for 10: documented retention periods, user-initiated deletion of indexed code and review data, a training opt-out for the hosted service, and independent corroboration.
